feed_title: Four-Sided Bolster Dog Bed, Soft Fibre Fill, Non-Slip Base, Washable Cover at 30C, Small 63 x 77cm to XL 127 x 94cm | PawLunova Ullswater
descriptionHtml:
Bolsters on four sides. Soft fill throughout. A room of their own.

Ullswater is a four-sided bolster dog bed with soft fibre filling in the base and walls, in four sizes from Small 63 × 77cm to XL 127 × 94cm.

Look at where they go when the house is busy. Under the table, behind the sofa, into the gap beside the bookcase. What they hunt for is something at their back and at both shoulders.

Four bolstered sides give them that on every edge, which is why a dog who has always slept under the furniture will often use this one out in the open.

What they get

  • A bolster on all four sides: An enclosed edge, rather than an open front.
  • Soft fibre in the walls and base: The sides give when they lean instead of pushing back.
  • A non-slip base: Steadier underfoot on smooth flooring.
  • A cover that unzips and washes at 30°C: Off, in, air-dried, back on.
  • Four sizes, 63 × 77cm to 127 × 94cm: Listed dimensions.

Best for: Dogs who sleep under furniture, and busy houses where they need their own place.

Why it is worth the money

The Small is £49 and the XL £99. For that there is an edge on four sides rather than three, filling in the walls as well as under them, a base that grips smooth floors and a cover that runs at 30°C. The XL is 127 × 94cm.

The trade-off is built in. Four sides means four sides to get over. With no open front, a dog who has stopped lifting their back legs high will manage a three-sided bed more easily.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)
Small63 × 77
Medium67 × 95
Large76 × 105
XL127 × 94

Those figures include the walls, so judge your dog against the usable space inside them. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Unzip the cover and run it at 30°C, as the sewn-in label says. Let it air-dry completely before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

The listed figures include the walls. Measure them curled and check the space inside.

How much is delivery, and how quickly does it arrive?

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. A window shows at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment methods can be selected during checkout.

Can a stiff dog get into a four-sided bed?

They step over a wall whichever way they come at it. For a dog who struggles, an open front is kinder.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

We stick to describing it. Soft fibre base, walls on four sides, non-slip bottom. Ask your vet whether that suits.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The cover unzips and takes a 30°C machine wash. Refit it once completely dry.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Some dogs want open floor. If so, we collect free inside 100 nights.

Choose their size and give them an edge on all four sides.
